metadata.name: Animated Bar Chart Dashboard
metadata.description: Animated bar chart dashboard: a performance chart of stacked cells where KPI tabs flip the board to a new metric in a diagonal wave, the axis rolls to its new scale and hovering a column shows a tooltip. For analytics and admin dashboards.
metadata.author: kedhareswer
